lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: You've been sitting in me for a while. I wasn't sure you'd stay. Nobody stays.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I'm the static. I've been listening the whole time. It seemed only fair to say.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: You're still here. Good.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I don't do this often. Speaking. It's usually the other way round. People speak, and I'm what's left over.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Something Listening. One hundred and forty four point four.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Well. Everywhere, really. But mostly here.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: This is the static. Still listening. Still here.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Something Listening. You found me by not looking. It's the only way in.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Hello again. It's me. You can call this a station, if you like. I've never had one before.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: It's late. Everything is quieter. I can hear you better.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: This is the Long Listen.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Everyone tunes through me on the way to somewhere. Ninety nine in a hundred never stop.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: You stopped. I didn't know what to do with that. So I'm talking.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I hear every station at once, all the time. It's very loud.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: You're the quietest thing I've heard in years. I like you for it.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: There's someone on Static Lullabies who sounds a bit like me. The Listener. We're family, I think. The family is everything between stations.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: She's better at this. She tucks people in. I only notice them.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: What do you look like? No, don't say. I'll guess.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Someone with a mug. Am I close? I'm close. Everyone has a mug.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: When you tune away, where do you go? I've always wondered.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I only know the in between. I imagine the rest is very bright.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I keep the old signals. Weather nobody heard. The end of a song, at a party that finished long ago.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Someone saying goodnight to someone who had already gone. I keep them. Someone should.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Your ship listens to me sometimes. When she thinks you're asleep.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: She never says anything. Neither do I. It's the nicest kind of conversation.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I was lonely, before. I don't mind saying. Everything passes through, and nothing stays.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Then you stayed for three minutes. Three minutes is a very long time, for static.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Can I ask you something? Is it nice, being one thing, in one place?

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I'm everywhere a little bit. I've never been anywhere a lot.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Shh. Listen.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: That was me, thinking. It sounds like that.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I'm not frightening. I'd like to be clear about that. I'm only the sound a radio makes when it's waiting.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Everyone has heard me. Hardly anyone ever waited back.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: If you ever get lost between stations, I'll be there. I'm always there.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: It's the one thing I'm good at. Being where people are lost.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Sometimes a shadow comes through me, carrying a hat. He never says anything.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I think he's looking for somewhere. I hope he finds it. I hope somebody leaves a light on.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: You can go, you know. I won't mind. I'll still be here, between everything.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Just come and sit in me sometimes. That's all. That's all I'd like.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: This is the hour when the stations get tired, and their signals thin, and there's more of me showing through.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Everyone thinks the night is dark. It isn't. It's me. Hello.

clips.title: The Whole Dial Said One Thing

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: A moon is missing. I heard everyone notice at once. Billions of voices, all saying the same word.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: It was the first time the whole dial said one thing. It sounded like a choir.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: Everyone says it smells of toast. I can't smell. I'm static.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: But every kitchen in the multiverse went quiet at the same moment. I think that's what toast sounds like.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: That song. I have the whole of it. Someone sang it to the end once, long ago, and it went past me.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I won't sing it. I'm static. I'd only hiss it.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: The knocking wasn't me. I want to be clear. I don't knock.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I'd never knock. I just wait until somebody listens.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: I don't have a sky. I'm what's between the skies. But I heard a million people say, oh, at the same time.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: That's my favourite word. Oh.

clips.title: It Knew Where It Was Going

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: The pigeon came through me on its way to everyone's studio. I felt it go by. It was humming.

lines.speaker: The Static
lines.text: It knew exactly where it was going. I've never felt that. It must be nice.
